--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/middleware/instrument.go
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+package middleware
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+
+	"myservice/internal/metrics"
+)
+
+func Instrument(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		start := time.Now()
+		rw := &responseWriter{ResponseWriter: w}
+		next.ServeHTTP(rw, r)
+		metrics.RequestsTotal.WithLabelValues(r.Method, r.URL.Path, fmt.Sprint(rw.status)).Inc()
+		metrics.RequestDuration.WithLabelValues(r.Method, r.URL.Path).Observe(time.Since(start).Seconds())
+	})
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/interceptors/logging.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import time
+import logging
+import grpc
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class LoggingInterceptor(grpc.ServerInterceptor):
+    def intercept_service(self, continuation, handler_call_details):
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        result = continuation(handler_call_details)
+        elapsed = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
+        logger.info(
+            "gRPC %s — %.1f ms",
+            handler_call_details.method,
+            elapsed,
+        )
+        return result
feat(interceptors): add gRPC server-side logging interceptor with latency

+use axum::http::{HeaderValue, Method};
+use tower_http::cors::{Any, CorsLayer};
+
+pub fn cors_layer(allowed_origins: &[&str]) -> CorsLayer {
+    let origins: Vec<HeaderValue> = allowed_origins
+        .iter()
+        .filter_map(|o| o.parse().ok())
+        .collect();
+    CorsLayer::new()
+        .allow_origin(origins)
+        .allow_methods([Method::GET, Method::POST, Method::PUT, Method::DELETE, Method::PATCH])
+        .allow_headers(Any)
+        .max_age(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3600))
+}
feat(middleware): add configurable CORS layer with allowlist-based origin validation

+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"

+func TestHealth(t *testing.T) {
+	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/health", nil)
+	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	handlers.Health(rec, req)
+	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
+		t.Fatalf("expected 200, got %d", rec.Code)
+	}
+	var body map[string]string
+	if err := json.NewDecoder(rec.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if body["status"] != "ok" {
+		t.Errorf("expected status ok, got %q", body["status"])
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import pytest
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
+from payments.processor import PaymentProcessor
+from payments.models import PaymentResult, PaymentStatus
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def processor():
+    return PaymentProcessor(api_key="test-key", timeout=5)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_charge_success(processor):
+    mock_result = PaymentResult(status=PaymentStatus.SUCCESS, charge_id="ch_123")
+    with patch.object(processor, "_call_gateway", new=AsyncMock(return_value=mock_result)):
+        result = await processor.charge(amount=1000, currency="usd", token="tok_visa")
+    assert result.status == PaymentStatus.SUCCESS
+    assert result.charge_id == "ch_123"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_charge_declined(processor):
+    mock_result = PaymentResult(status=PaymentStatus.DECLINED, charge_id=None)
+    with patch.object(processor, "_call_gateway", new=AsyncMock(return_value=mock_result)):
+        result = await processor.charge(amount=1000, currency="usd", token="tok_declined")
+    assert result.status == PaymentStatus.DECLINED
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_charge_timeout(processor):
+    with patch.object(processor, "_call_gateway", side_effect=TimeoutError):
+        with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
+            await processor.charge(amount=500, currency="usd", token="tok_visa")
